notes.title: Patch 1.0.0
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
- Added Bill Decker's ending.
- Added new art to the tutorial character.
- Reduced wait time for new arrival to be added to your hand.
- Added a new line to the tutorial.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed enemy battle spell particles lingering after battles.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.13
notes.content:
[h3]New Character Endings[/h3]
- Every character (except Bill, temporarily) now has a unique ending for winning a Mastwork run as them.

[h3]New Assets[/h3]
- Flying minions have a new visual indicator.
- The Garden background has been fixed for 1440p displays.

[h3]Misc Changes[/h3]
- If you skip a masterwork while drafting, you won't be offered another one in your run.
- The ??? button at the masterwork alter has been moved to where the end round button is.
- Music starts a little sooner ahead of the Astral Plane.

[h3]Controller Improvements[/h3]
- You now have to hold the end turn button for half a second before it accepts (same with skips on the encounter reward screen).
- Improved card pile grid scrolling.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed battle spells beams not rendering.
- Fixed a bug that prevents the last card in your hand from being selected.
- Fixed some cards being incorrectly sized at certain resolutions.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.10
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed a crash when starting a run as the tutorial character, or opening the stats screen.
- Fixed a crash in the tutorial.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.9
notes.content:
[h3]Art and Sound Changes[/h3]
- The main menu has been updated.
- Moonlit Acolyte has new art.
- Replaced the draw pile, discard pile, exhaust pile, and map assets.
- Replaced the moon asset on the map.
- Added a variety of new sound effects.

[h3]New Gameplay Settings[/h3]
- Battle speed can now be changed from this screen.
- Highest battle speed has been sped up.
- Second highest battle speed is now the same as the previous highest battle speed.
- Added Skip Tier-Up Animation up setting.
- Added Skip Map Transition setting.
- Added Instant Enemy Deployment setting.
- Moved Unlock All to this screen.

[h3]New Unlockable Alt Portraits[/h3]
- Achieving all 3 medals with a character unlocks their alternate portrait, which can be toggled on from the choose character screen.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Save files now save to a temp file before overwriting your working save file (to prevent help data corruption).
- Fixed being unable to select the bottom card of your deck on controller if its the only one in the row.
- Fixed undefined tutorial message while playing on controller.
- Removed the tutorial character from silently appearing in the stats screen.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.8
notes.content:
The version number skipped 0.9.6 and 0.9.7 because there were a few demo-only updates which weren't published to the playtest immediately.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Entropy Ash no longer crashes the game when the relic is chosen.
- Fixes a crash when escape is pressed quickly after pressing the Quick Restart button.
- If settings.json becomes corrupted, it will no longer crash the game on load.
- Fixed Infestation calling Bee's "Parasites" in English.
- A lot of random controller and localization fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes and Misc[/h3]
- Fixed cards from the collection lingering on screen after the collection is closed.
- Adds new selection indicator to the choose leader screen.
- Adds missing controller input functionality.
- Fixed some localization issues.
- Potentially fixed some rare crashes.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.4
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes and Misc[/h3]
- Actually fixed daily challenge crash on 1440p displays.
- Sped up daily challenge load time by about half.
- Fixed various localization issues.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.3
notes.content:
[h3]UI Changes[/h3]
- Added a new loading screen to the start of the game.
- Removed Render Mode graphics setting.
- All graphics settings except UI Anchor Width now require a restart for changes to apply.
- Added a skip button to the credits.
- Improved the Lyceum win ending sequence.
- Fixed Bill Decker, Hyphen, and Sonoya not using the correct map pawn.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed crash on the daily challenge.
- Fixed the destroy pile sometimes being unselectable.
- Fixed destroyed battle spells not entering the destroy pile.
- Fixed card piles displaying incorrect counts on save/continue.
- Fixed red giant's buff remaining indefinitely if you save/continue a run while it was in your position (this fix only applies to runs started on Patch 0.9.3).
- Potentially fixed an issue where music stems could get out of sync with one another.
- Potentially fixed bad loop points in the soundtrack.
- Fixed the mana numbers sometimes disappearing or changing colors.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2
notes.content:
[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
- Added a new application icon.
- Cleaned up the daily challenge UI.

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
- Porch-3 Octopus nerfed slightly.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed softlock after beating the moon with a leader for the first time.
- Fixed Blood Mist using old text.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.1
notes.content:
[h3]UI Changes[/h3]
- The daily challenge has new UI (still missing some polish)
- Added a continue button to the masterwork unlock scene so it doesn't instantly continue when you may not be ready.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed crash when unlocking a new character.
- Fixed preview card in the collection lingering when closed.
- Fixed tooltips lingering on screen if a card/leader is destroyed while your mouse is hovered over it.
- Fixed battle spell beams and card text staying visible in the masterwork unlock area scene.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.0
notes.content:
[h3]New and Improved Graphics[/h3]
- Widescreen resolutions with pixel perfect scaling up to 2K are now supported.
- Non 16:9 resolutions are now supported.
- The game is no longer locked at 60fps.

[h3]Daily Challenge Improvements[/h3]
- You can now view previous daily challenge results.
- Canceling the daily challenge will no longer softlock your screen.

[h3]New UI Art[/h3]
- All cards and leaders have finished art.
- The choose leader screen has new art.
- The stats screen has new art.
- The card library has some new art.
- The Masterwork interface has been replaced with a new area with a new music track.
- Credits have been added.

[h3]Card Balance Changes[/h3]
- Overcharge buff decreased [+10/+10 -> +8/+8].
- Lunar Eclipse deck empty buff increased [+6/+6 -> +7/+7].

[h3]Encounter Balance Changes[/h3]
- Beekeepers lose 1 Health.
- Porch-3 Octopus buffed.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.23
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed Adrenaline still using old English text.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.22
notes.content:
[h3]New Feature: Stats[/h3]
- You can now view stats to see your most played leaders, most drafted cards, biggest minion, etc.
- Some caveats: Leader stats should be accurate, but draft stats were only added within the last few weeks, so it won't include stats from before May 4th. Card stats will probably be somewhat inaccurate, with some stats being tracked incorrectly (until now) and others are only beginning to be tracked now.

[h3]New Feature: Unlock All Content[/h3]
- There is now a button to enable all unlockable content. This can be enabled/disabled at any time from the main menu via the settings button.

[h3]Localization Update[/h3]
- The game's Chinese, Korean, and Japanese translations have been updated and re-enabled.
- Your default language is now determined by your language in Steam

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
- Slightly increased the odds of the first 3 cards you see in a draft being Legendary.
- Shooting Star, Red Giant, Little Dipper gain "Destroy this in 4 rounds"
- Red Giant buff increased [+1/+1 -> +2/+1].
- Little Dipper now triggers off any spell played, not just Onboard.
- Carrion Rose Attack reduced [3 -> 2], cost reduced [2 -> 1].
- Wing Commander buff increased [+1/+1 -> +1/+2].
- Moonlight Enchantress Health increased [5 -> 7].
- Adrenaline reworded to improve clarity, loses "for a round" Exhaust clause.
- Jean-Paul Gardinette cost reduced [4 -> 3].

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed String Theory freezing the game if it is played with too few cards in deck to get 6 in your hand.
- Fixed Medal Detector still giving only +1/+1.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.21
notes.content:
[h3]Character Balance Changes[/h3]
- Hyphen Von Battalia now reads "Skip the first encounter of each region. You start with +2 Max Mana and draft 1 fewer cards each round."

[h3]Card Balance Changes[/h3]
- Shield Carrier cost and Attack reduced [2 -> 1].
- Medal Detector Attack reduced [3 -> 1], buff increased [+1/+1 -> +2/+2].
- Eternity Perfume buff increased [+2/+2 -> +3/+2].
- Harmonize buff increased [+1/+1 -> +1/+2].
- Shattersmith Attack increased [+4 -> +6].
- Moonlight Enchantress Attack buff increased [+2 > +3].
- Dread Moss Health increased [6 -> 9].
- Towering Ent cost reduced [10 -> 9].
- Euphoria base buff increased [+1/+1 -> +2/+2].
- Battle Symphony cost reduced [6 -> 5].
- Soundstorm cost reduced [7 -> 6].
- Reclaimer Vott buff increased [+1/+1 -> +2/+1].
- Understudy Sonia Attack increased [2 -> 3].

[h3]Encounter Balance Changes[/h3]
- Lab Incident stats reduced [9/30 -> 7/28].
- Finale Doublestrike minion Health reduced [500 -> 300].
- Finale Ranged minions Health reduced [90 -> 60].
- Finale leader Health reduced [5 -> 4].

notes.title: Patch 0.8.20
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed crash upon entering The Finale.
- Fixed a crash on startup affecting old saved runs.
- Fixed Call still retaining the card.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.19
notes.content:
[h3]New Art[/h3]
- Pesticide now has art.
- A History of Inland, Baby Phoenix now have art.
- Tub-3 Mech (now golems fight now has art.

[h3]Audio[/h3]
- Intro Jingle is now considered music.

[h3]Card Balance Changes[/h3]
- String Theory cost reduced [2 -> 1], now reads "Draw a card. Repeat until you have at least 6 cards in hand."
- Chaotic Caster no longer activates if it has less than 1 Health.
- Hail cost reduced [4 -> 3].
- Quartermaster cost reduced [4 -> 3], now reads "When you play a battle spell, reduce each friendly minion's Activated Ability cost by (2) until next activation."
- Astral Scribe loses "Up to 10 times each round."
- Lifedrinker Health increased [2 -> 3].
- Deeproot Dryad Activated Ability cost reduced [2 -> 1].
- Adrenaline now reads "Give a minion +1/+1. Discard a card to return this from exhaust to your hand. Exhaust this for a round."
- Burst cost reduced [3 -> 2].
- Fleshy Toadstool renamed to Mushroom Tea, now activates whenever an On Death effect is triggered.
- Call can now generate Rare and Legendary minions, but only once per round.
- All keys have been renamed. Black Key redesigned to "One random Star Card in each encounter reward costs (1) more until played.

[h3]Encounter Balance Changes[/h3]
- Golem fists Health reduced [8 -> 3] and gain Shield.
- Giant Golem Health reduced [15 -> 12].
- Fury Punch changed to add Stunned to your hand and only give them if the fists survive their attacks.
- Infestation cost reduced [5 -> 2].

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a crash caused by an Overseer or Overseer's Whip attempting to make a minion that's already dead attack.
- Fixed destroying Black Light causing secret star cards to stop appearing even if you have another Black Light in your relic bar.
- Fixed saving/continuing with Asteroid causing battle spells to have negative spell power.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.18
notes.content:
[h3]New Content[/h3]
- Fleshy Toadstool (Relic) When a friendly minion with an On Death effect dies, give it +1 Attack permanently.

[h3]New Audio[/h3]
- Added a startup jingle to match our studio logo.
- Added new music that plays when your run ends which changes depending on success the ending you achieve.

[h3]Card Balance Changes[/h3]
- Plaster Cast loses "Exhaust this" and gains "Costs (1) more for each time this has been played."
- Lyceum cost decreased [1 -> 0].
- Deep Copy now specifies that it summons "exact" copies.
- Garden now specifies that it creates "plain" copies.

[h3]UI Changes[/h3]
- Tooltip added for "Plain Copy."

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fix Key Lock screen crashing or not appearing on continued runs.
- Fixed incorrect text in Bill Decker's tooltip.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.17
notes.content:
[h3]Encounter Balance[/h3]
- Bees can no longer activate if they have 0 or less Health.
- Porch-3 Octo fight's Quick Attack minions stats increased [5/4 -> 6/8].
- Shielded Stage Performer Health increased [5 -> 15].
- 6-Key Final Fight Deathtouch minion Health reduced [20 -> 10].

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- 6-Key fight will now load correctly when saving and continuing.
- Pesiticide is now ACTUALLY only able to target minions.
- Regimental Gong properly loses all gained attack next round, instead of just 1.
- Removed "Can't attack leaders" text from Sonoya's minions, since they now only gain that from a battle spell.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.16
notes.content:
[h3]Card Balance Changes[/h3]
- Academy cost increased [0 -> 3].
- Lyceum cost increased [0 -> 1].
- Plaster Cast cost decreased [1 -> 0].
- Pesticide cost decreased [2 -> 1] can no longer can target battle spells.
- Overseer Attack buffs will now be applied before any forced attacks occur.
- Quartermaster cost increased [3 -> 4].
- Petri Dish now reads "Start of Round: Obtain a Microbiome." Microbiome reads: "Start of Round: Draw a card."

[h3]Encounter Balance Changes[/h3]
- Moon-3 is now much much harder to cheese by pulling your minions back and ending round.
- Bee Keepers given +2 Attack.
- Battle of The Bands now summons just 1 battle spell by default.
- Lab Incidents given +1/+2.
- Right-most final fight minion replaced with a Deathtouch minion. Taunt minions given -20 Health and Shield.
- Minions re-summoned by Curse of Moonlight will no longer have higher priority when choosing the attacker.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Medal Detector now works correctly with Petri Dish.
- 1/1 Cleave Crows now work with Sonia, Overseer, and Moonlight Enchantress. They're also less prone to getting stuck in weird places.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.15
notes.content:
[h3]Character Balance Changes[/h3]
- Plaster Cast cost increased [0 -> 1].
- Captain Ego now starts with an additional Onboard.
- Home Sickness now has Eternal.
- Nepotism now reads, Repeat the effect of the last Star Card you played.
- String Theory now reads, Return all discarded minions to your draw pile, then shuffle your draw pile. Draw 4 cards.
- Slay Solari now gives +1 Attack against leaders to all friendly minions, not just one.
- Pesticide cost increased [1 -> 2].

[h3]Card Balance Changes[/h3]
- Stubborn Bloke cost reduced [4 -> 1], now reads, After you exhaust this, [play it -> return it to your hand]. 
- Manaburst rarity increased [Rare -> Legendary] and can no longer reduce the cost of other Manabursts.
- Astral Scribe now limited to 10 uses per round.
- Adrenaline Exhaust this changed to Exhaust this for a round.
- Recycle Rarity reduced [Legendary -> Rare] and gains "Exhaust this for a round."
- Parting Song cost reduced [5 -> 1], rarity reduced [Legendary -> Rare], now reads, Give a friendly battle spell +5 Spell Power and Destroy this.
- Bravo rarity increased [Rare -> Legendary], now reads, Play an exact copy of a friendly battle spell. It gains Destroy this.
- Porch now reads, Shield your leader. (Negates damage once, then breaks!)

[h3]Relic Balance Changes[/h3]
- Mother's Mitt gains the additional clause "and draws 1 less card each round."
- Scalemail gains the additional clause "Star cards cost (1) more." It now also increases current Health instead of just Max Health.
- Regimental Gong now reads, Start of Battle: The leader with the most battle spells in play has +1 Attack this battle.

[h3]Art and UI Changes[/h3]
- Hyphen's character portrait has been adjusted.
- Reduced Bill and Hyphen's daily challenge icon sizes.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Sleight of Hand will now correctly draw 1 card if it exhausts 1 card.
- Crescent Hook will no longer break if you quit and reload a run.
- Meditate will now work correctly with Lunar Condenser.
- Fixed Bill's tooltip incorrectly saying his Max Tier is 99.
- Fixed text wrapping in Poppit's unlock screen.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.14
notes.content:
[h3]New Art[/h3]
- Bill Decker and Hyphen Von Battalia now have art.
- Push and Stoke now have art.
- Bill Decker's starter card art has been updated.
- New art for Garden-3 and Porch-3 encounters.
- Brightened art on Stage Performers and updated the Grand Finale.

[h3]Encounter Balance Changes[/h3]
- Nerfed two Garden-1 encounters.
- Garden-3 Parasite (now Bee) fight adjusted to no longer be a hard counter to summon strategies and less of a pushover to everything else.
- Nerfed leader Attack of Porch-1 windup soldier encounter.
- Changed Porch-2 Battlefield Scavenger encounter leader from 1/3 to 2/1.
- Replaced a Shield Jockey in Porch-2 General Koi encounter with Field Nurse.
- Heavily reduced stats of stage performers.

[h3]Card Balance Changes[/h3]
- Dove of Avon Health increased [2 -> 3].
- Blissful Bestie Health reduced [4 -> 3].
- Pyroflamer damage increased [3 -> 4], Attack decreased [3 -> 2].
- Comet Catcher won't attempt to add cards to your hand if your hand is full.
- Stubborn Bloke cost increased [2 -> 4].
- Quartermaster cost reduction increased [1 -> 2], cost increased [2 -> 3].
- Deeproot Dryad cost reduced [3 -> 2], Stats reduced [4/3 -> 3/2].
- Manhole Cover buff decreased [+2/+2 -> +2/+1].
- Bind can now be played if you've already played Bind this round (for no effect).

[h3]Card Wording Changes[/h3]
- Cards that give Shield to minions now use consistent wording to other cards that give enchantments (ie: "Give a friendly minion Shield" instead of "Shield a friendly minion.")
- Field Nurse and Anti-Magic Shield now specify that they will only give Shield to minions that don't currently have Shield.
- Composting now specifies "for each card discarded."
- Stoke reworded to "Upgrade all current and future copies of Stoke this run."
- Meditate reworded to "Increase the cost of Meditate by (1) this run."

[h3]UI Changes[/h3]
- Add additional error messages to the daily challenge.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.13
notes.content:
[h3]New Feature: Auto-Saving![/h3]
- Your progress in a run will now be saved automatically at the start of each round.
- Added a "Continue Run" button to the Main Menu.
- This feature may have bugs! Please report any you find to #bug-reports in Discord.

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
- Flying Stage Performer gains Quick Attack instead.

[h3]UI Changes[/h3]
- The "New Character Unlocked" screen now also displays the character's name and ability.
- Added confirmation prompts to "Return to Main Menu" and "Quit to Desktop" buttons in the pause menu.
- Increased entries per page of the daily challenge scoreboard to 10.
- Sprout renamed to Stoke.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Allison Lycette's enemy encounter no longer uses the wrong character background.
- Fixed the Mana Next Round indicator sometimes appearing in red text.
- Fixed card cost color not changing to red/green when drawn or when viewing a card pile.
- Fixed a typo in Deep Breath's textbox.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.12
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a crash in Bill Decker's enemy encounter.
- Fixed an incorrect battle spell in Allison Lycette's enemy encounter.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.11
notes.content:
[h3]New Art[/h3]
- The two Lyceum-3 encounters with missing art now have art.

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
- Blood Mist cost increased [2 -> 3].
- The Taker's Dragon cost reducled [1 -> 0].
- Replica Moon cost reduced [1 -> 0], buff increased [+1/+1 -> +2/+2].
- Lyceum-3 "Nightmare" encounter redesigned.

[h3]UI Changes[/h3]
- Winning with all 6 keys now displays different text on the end screen.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a crash when winning a run with all 6 keys.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.10
notes.content:
[h3]UI[/h3]
- Added warnings for if you aren't connected to the internet or aren't logged into Steam and try to load the daily challenge.
- Added button prompt to playtesting rules message and choose langauge message when using controller.
- Removed "/18" from the score counter in the daily challenge.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed Harmonize's cost not acknowledging battle spells that remain in play from the previous round.
- Fixed not being able to close card pile views on controller.
